name: @role-orchestrator/model-stats
description: M8-02 read-only model performance statistics: strict UsageEvent schema (cost is contract-level unknown - no approved rate source exists), hermetic JSONL usage extractors for the claude stream-json and codex exec --json dialects (validated against the real M8-01 captures, never against a live CLI), an append-only PerformanceStore with optional JSONL file persistence, a human-readable report() that exposes no scheduling-decision API, and a BudgetRefinement hook emitting read-only per-model threshold suggestions (ready | insufficient-data; token counts only, each with its derivation basis; adoption requires maintainer approval in its own batch). Statistics are descriptive only: nothing in this package selects, switches, or reroutes a model.
